description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid ranged attacks (0.60 or 1.50 each), grants [Quick Cast 1] and [Weakness +9% Boost (15s)]/ [Quick Cast] and [Weakness +30% Boost (15s)]/ [Quick Cast], [Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] and [ATK and MAG +15%, DEF and RES +25% (8s)] to all allies if there are 0-3/4/5 VII allies in the party, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Awoken Stoic Sunglasses] and [Linked Materia Mode II (Lightning, Earth)] to the user

description.name: Weakness +9% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 9% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: ATK and MAG +15%, DEF and RES +25% (8s)
description.text: ATK and MAG +15%, DEF and RES +25%

description.name: Awoken Stoic Sunglasses
description.text: Unlimited Earth and Lightning hones, Earth and Lightining abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth and Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Linked Materia Mode II (Lightning, Earth)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Earth with Stacking] after using a Lightning/Earth ability
